searchText: I don't remember agreeing to EIP-8045 conclusively, but maybe I missed the memo. I am strongly against monkeying with the PTC or the attestation committees, and especially changing one (PTC) without changing the other (attestations), because in Lighthouse's caches we store them together (they have the same lookahead and can be calculated from the same state currently). In general I'm really hesitant about changing any of these properties, because we've been burnt before (at Fulu) by subtle assumptions baked into our caches. To me it seems like the risk-reward ratio is heavily skewed against these sorts of changes being desirable to make. I could be convinced to implement proposer-only EIP-8045 if the consensus is there, but it will slow us down. Just my 2c We have not yet agreed to 8045. And as it is currently spec’d, it only affects the proposer lookahead, not the attestation committees or PTCs. Would still prefer not to touch PTC or attester duties I feel the same way. yeah we had multiple discussions about not touching any attestation duties. excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
I don't remember agreeing to EIP-8045 conclusively, but maybe I missed the memo.

I am strongly against monkeying with the PTC or the attestation committees, and especially changing one (PTC) without changing the other (attestations), because in Lighthouse's caches we store them together (they have the same lookahead and can be calculated from the same state currently).

In general I'm really hesitant about changing any of these properties, because we've been burnt before (at Fulu) by subtle assumptions baked into our caches. To me it seems like the risk-reward ratio is heavily skewed against these sorts of changes being desirable to make.

I could be convinced to implement proposer-only EIP-8045 if the consensus is there, but it will slow us down.

Just my 2c
